title: Fixed Bail Rotor Front Spool and Curved Foot Reel
description: One newly authored complete empty spinning-reel-style exterior in a fixed inverted display pose on its own flat mounting foot. A continuous curved stem connects the full foot to a thick rounded side gear-housing appearance. The front axis supports one open-front cup rotor, an independently stepped spool with a genuine annular winding recess and a front knob. Two full rotor arms carry one continuous semicircular bail-like wire around and ahead of the spool, with visible clearance from the spool lip. A separate transverse side crank and axial handgrip complete the whole reel. This is not the old fishing rod kit with the rod removed or the old bare double-flange winch rescaled: the curved stem, side housing and front cup/bail relation are new geometry. No old visible meshes imported. One model zero scenes, four opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up and complete horizontal-envelope-centred ground datum. Static illustrative equipment exterior only: no internal gears, line, winding, drag, braking, bail motion, spool oscillation, mounting compatibility, manufacture, fishing or safety capability.
